questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What planet is closest in size to Earth?
A. Mars B. Venus C. Mercury
Answer: B. Venus and Earth have a similar size, mass, and proximity to the Sun, leading Venus to be often referred to as Earth’s “sister planet.” The diameter of Venus is just about 650 kilometers less than that of Earth.
questions.en: Which planet is closest in size to Earth, often called Earth's "sister planet"?
questions.de: Welcher Planet kommt der Erde in der Größe am nächsten und wird oft ihr „Schwesterplanet“ genannt?

timeline.labelEn: Babylonian Venus tablet of Ammi-Saduqa: the oldest known record of observations of Venus
timeline.labelDe: Babylonische Venustafel des Ammi-saduqa: die älteste bekannte Aufzeichnung von Venusbeobachtungen

questions.notes: Venus's diameter (12,103.6 km) is 638.4 km less than Earth's; the card rounds to 'about 650'.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Where do splash tetra fish typically lay their eggs?
A. On other marine animals
B. On mud
C. On leaves
Answer: C. Splash tetra fish are known for their unique breeding behavior where they lay their eggs underneath overhanging leaves above the water. The male fish then splashes water onto the eggs to keep them moist until they hatch.
questions.en: Where does the splash tetra lay its eggs, which the male then keeps moist by splashing water onto them?
questions.de: Wo legt der Spritzsalmler seine Eier ab, die das Männchen dann feucht hält, indem es Wasser darauf spritzt?
questions.answerDe: Auf Blättern, die über das Wasser hängen

timeline.labelEn: Charles Tate Regan describes the splash tetra (as Copeina arnoldi)
timeline.labelDe: Charles Tate Regan beschreibt den Spritzsalmler (als Copeina arnoldi)

questions.notes: The splash tetra is a freshwater fish, so the card's option A 'other marine animals' is a distractor only.
